name: PT Kusuma Kemindo Sentosa Tbk
summary: PT Kusuma Kemindo Sentosa Tbk operates as a prominent Indonesian enterprise, specializing in the distribution of a broad spectrum of industrial and consumer goods. The company's primary focus is on supplying commodity and specialty chemical compounds, essential food ingredients, chemicals for the construction industry, and other related materials throughout Indonesia. Their comprehensive product portfolio serves various sectors, encompassing: Materials for both natural leather and synthetic production. Components crucial for manufacturing adhesives, textiles, rubber, foam, and shoe soles. A range of items for paints, protective coatings, printing inks, thinners, diverse plastics, resins, and PVC pipes. Ingredients and products for the food and beverage industry. Supplies for the construction and aluminum sectors. Various wood finishing solutions. Founded in 1990, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Jakarta, Indonesia.
